# Dentravo Signal Full Context

Dentravo Signal is a public dental product intelligence surface at https://dentravo.com/signal/.

Signal ranks consumer dental products and clinic technology using a visible scoring model:

- Clinical evidence: 25
- Dental validation: 20
- Usability: 15
- Durability: 15
- Value: 10
- Claims safety: 10
- Support: 5

Revenue rule:

1. Product is researched.
2. Score is locked.
3. Verdict is published.
4. Affiliate links or qualified demo lead CTAs may appear only after publication.

V1 explicitly excludes sponsors, dropshipping, paid placement, and vendor-written rankings.

Launch URLs:

- https://dentravo.com/signal/
- https://dentravo.com/signal/best/electric-toothbrushes/
- https://dentravo.com/signal/products/oral-b-io-series-6/
- https://dentravo.com/signal/innovations/chairside-ai-governance/
- https://dentravo.com/signal/methodology/
- https://dentravo.com/signal/submit-product/

Current launch product verdict:

Oral-B iO Series 6 is the Dentravo Signal launch winner for electric toothbrushes. Signal score: 86/100. It wins because it pairs category-level evidence for powered brushing with pressure feedback, practical ownership cost, and restrained claims. Negative notes: replacement heads cost money, app features are not required, and no toothbrush replaces professional dental care.

Current clinic innovation:

Chairside AI is moving from novelty to governance problem. Signal judges dental AI by claims scope, data handling, explainability, audit trail, clinician responsibility, and escalation workflow before any demo-lead economics.

Disclaimers:

Dentravo is not a healthcare provider and does not provide medical or dental advice. Signal pages are educational product intelligence only. Consult a licensed dentist for dental conditions.
